meta.note: Seed bank. Every game needs ~40 items per level before public launch; this pack gives the working structure plus a playable first set. Add items by appending to the arrays — no code changes required.

prompt.en: Put the steps of wudu in the right order.
prompt.ar: رتّب خطوات الوضوء بالترتيب الصحيح.

Wash your feet up to the ankles

explain.en: We begin with the intention, then wash from the top down — hands, face, arms, feet.

explain.en: Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Sharjah, Ajman, Umm Al Quwain, Fujairah and Ras Al Khaimah.

prompt.en: How many prayers do Muslims pray each day?

prompt.en: Order the full sequence of wudu, right side before left.
prompt.ar: رتّب خطوات الوضوء كاملة، مع تقديم اليمين على اليسار.

steps.en: Wash right arm then left, to the elbows
steps.ar: غسل اليد اليمنى ثم اليسرى إلى المرفقين

steps.en: Wash right foot then left, to the ankles
steps.ar: غسل القدم اليمنى ثم اليسرى إلى الكعبين

explain.en: The ears are wiped with the head, and the right limb precedes the left throughout.
explain.ar: تُمسح الأذنان مع الرأس، ويُقدَّم العضو الأيمن على الأيسر في كل غسل.

prompt.en: Which UAE site is inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List?

options.en: The Cultural Sites of Al Ain

explain.en: Hafit, Hili, Bidaa Bint Saud and the Oases of Al Ain were inscribed in 2011 — the country's first World Heritage listing.
explain.ar: أُدرجت مواقع حفيت وهيلي وبدع بنت سعود وواحات العين عام ٢٠١١، وهي أول إدراج للدولة في التراث العالمي.

prompt.en: Which pillar of Islam is obligatory once in a lifetime for those who are able?

prompt.en: What went wrong?

options.en: The examples were all too similar to each other
The robot needs a faster processor
Twenty photos is far too many

fix_task.en: Add 3 examples that would fix it.

scenario.en: A robot sorting school photos learned that anyone holding a football is a boy.
scenario.ar: روبوت يصنّف صور المدرسة تعلّم أن كل من يحمل كرة قدم هو ولد.

prompt.en: Why is that a problem?
prompt.ar: لماذا تُعدّ هذه مشكلة؟

options.en: It needs more photos of footballs

mission.en: Write 3 IF/THEN rules so the robot waters plants in a school garden.
mission.ar: اكتب ٣ قواعد شرطية ليسقي الروبوت نباتات حديقة المدرسة.

edge_cases.en: The soil is dry but it has just started raining.
edge_cases.ar: التربة جافة لكن المطر بدأ للتو.

edge_cases.en: The soil is dry and the tank is empty.
The soil is dry at 1 pm in July.
edge_cases.ar: التربة جافة الساعة الواحدة ظهرًا في يوليو.

edge_cases.en: A sensor is broken and reports nothing.
edge_cases.ar: أحد الحساسات معطّل ولا يرسل قراءة.

edge_cases.en: The soil is wet but a plant looks droopy.
edge_cases.ar: التربة رطبة لكن النبتة تبدو ذابلة.

items.note: No single rule set passes all 5 — the learning is that rules need exceptions and a human fallback. Score on how many edge cases are handled, and require a reflection on the one they couldn't solve.

levels.note: Palette deliberately includes near-shades to raise discrimination difficulty. Every collectible must also carry a distinct SHAPE so colourblind players are never disadvantaged.
